lines.en: label futabadorm25:
: Futaba, are you in there?
lines.zh: : Futaba，你在里面吗？

lines.en: : Just a second, [futabamaster]!
lines.zh: : 稍等一下，[futabamaster]！

lines.en: scene black
I take a step back and wait for Futaba to finish getting ready.
lines.zh: 我后退一步，等 Futaba 收拾好。

lines.en: I also hope that {i}getting ready{/i} doesn't constitute anything out of the ordinary- because if she were to get dressed up for this, I'd feel at least a little bad for looking...entirely normal.
lines.zh: 我也希望她所谓的“{i}准备{/i}”不包括什么特别的环节——因为如果她为这次出门特意打扮，我至少会为自己穿得……再普通不过而感到有点过意不去。

lines.en: Not that I have anything else to wear in the first place, but yeah.
lines.zh: 虽然我本来也没什么别的衣服可穿，不过是啊。

lines.en: This is her first “date” ever, though, so who knows?
lines.zh: 不过这毕竟是她人生第一次“约会”，所以谁知道呢？

lines.en: scene bookdateredux1
: Hey! I'm ready to go whenever you are.
lines.zh: : 嘿！我准备好了，你随时可以出发。

lines.en: Oh, good. Looks like I may have jumped the gun in worrying about her getting dressed up for this.
lines.zh: 哦，太好了。看来我担心她会为此特意打扮，是操心得太早了。

lines.en: But...I should probably be a nice person and compliment her anyway. I think that's how this sort of thing is supposed to go.
lines.zh: 不过……我大概该做个好人，还是夸她一句。我想这种场合本来就该这样。

lines.en: : Hey, Futaba. You look nice.
lines.zh: : 嘿，Futaba。你今天很好看。

lines.en: scene bookdateredux2
: What? No...I look the same as always.
lines.zh: : 什么？没有……我跟平时一模一样啊。

lines.en: : I was...originally planning on wearing something else, but...I decided against it at the last second.
lines.zh: : 我……本来打算穿另一套的，不过……最后一刻改主意了。

lines.en: Ahh, so my hunch wasn't entirely off after all.
lines.zh: 啊，看来我的直觉也不算完全错了。

lines.en: scene bookdateredux1
: But, umm...thank you anyway, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 不过，嗯……还是谢谢你，Sensei……

lines.en: : The sun still hasn’t set, so I figured we could walk there instead of taking the bus. Is that okay with you?
lines.zh: : 太阳还没落山，所以我想我们走着过去，不坐公交。你可以吗？

lines.en: : I kind of figured that's what was going to happen anyway, so yeah.
lines.zh: : 我本来就猜会是这个结果，所以行啊。

lines.en: scene bookdateredux2
: So...you're okay with that many people seeing us together?...Because I know you said it was fine if it was the book store, but walking around in public is-
lines.zh: : 那么……被那么多人看到我们在一起，你也不介意吗？……因为你说过在书店里没关系，可是走在公共场合就——

lines.en: : Futaba, stop being weird and just focus on enjoying yourself today. I really don't care who sees us walking around together. It's not a big deal.
lines.zh: : Futaba，别犯怪了，今天专心好好玩就行。我真不在乎谁看到我们走在一起。这没什么大不了的。

lines.en: scene bookdateredux3
: R-Right! Yeah! I'm sorry...I'm just a little nervous, I think...
lines.zh: : 对……对！是啊！抱歉……我想我只是有点紧张……

lines.en: : But if you're okay with me- Uhh...if you're okay with {i}going,{/i} we can leave now...
lines.zh: : 不过如果你不介意我——呜……如果你可以{i}出发{/i}了，我们现在就可以走……

lines.en: : Good save, Futaba. Lead the way, I guess. I'm ready when you are.
lines.zh: : 掩饰得不错，Futaba。那带路吧。我随时都行。

lines.en: scene black
scene bookdateredux4
: Hmm...It should be somewhere around here...at least based on the address my friend gave me.
lines.zh: : 嗯……应该就在这一带……至少按我朋友给的地址是这样。

lines.en: : How long ago did this place open, exactly?
lines.zh: : 这地方具体是什么时候开的？

lines.en: : A few weeks ago, I think? I’ve heard nothing but good things, though.
lines.zh: : 我想是几周前吧？不过我听到的全都是好评。

lines.en: : And this friend of yours is reliable? You're sure we're not about to walk into some mugging or something?
lines.zh: : 你那个朋友靠谱吗？你确定我们不是正要走进什么抢劫现场之类的？

lines.en: scene bookdateredux5
: That would certainly be a strange plot twist, don't you think?
lines.zh: : 那肯定会是个相当奇怪的剧情转折，你不觉得吗？

lines.en: : Don't smile while acknowledging the probability of us being robbed. It's improper date behavior.
lines.zh: : 别一边承认我们可能被抢一边还笑。这可不符合约会礼仪。

lines.en: : I'm sure we'll be fine, Sensei. My friend is plenty reliable.
lines.zh: : 我保证不会有事的，Sensei。我朋友很靠谱。

lines.en: scene bookdateredux4
: But I guess it wouldn't hurt to check for their address online as well...
lines.zh: : 不过我想，上网再查一下地址也没什么坏处……

lines.en: : Just in case she got her numbers mixed up.
lines.zh: : 以防她把门牌号记混了。

lines.en: : Worst case scenario, we get totally lost and do something else. There's a pretty good porn shop around here that I wouldn't mind taking you to.
lines.zh: : 最坏的情况，我们彻底迷路，然后去干点别的。这附近有家挺不错的色情商店，我不介意带你去。

lines.en: scene bookdateredux6
: I'd...really rather not go some place like that...
lines.zh: : 我……真的不太想去那种地方……

lines.en: : Would you prefer just...staying lost instead?
lines.zh: : 那你宁愿……就这么一直迷路下去？

lines.en: scene bookdateredux4
: I...don't think I'd be opposed.
lines.zh: : 我……倒是不反对。

lines.en: : Getting lost in a...mostly random place with you...seems like it might be kind of fun.
lines.zh: : 和你在一个……基本陌生的地方迷路……听起来好像还挺有意思的。

lines.en: : Sure. Except this isn't really a {i}random{/i} place and we both have GPS apps on our phones. Actually being {i}lost{/i} around here seems unlikely.
lines.zh: : 是啊。只不过这地方其实也不算{i}陌生{/i}，而且我们俩手机里都有 GPS。在这儿真的{i}迷路{/i}的可能性不大。

lines.en: scene bookdateredux5
: Hahah...I guess that’s true.
lines.zh: : 哈哈……我想也是。

lines.en: : But...fortunately for both of us, it looks like we found the place after all.
lines.zh: : 不过……对我们两个来说幸运的是，看来我们还是找到了。

lines.en: scene black
I turn around to find a sign advertising the book store we've been on the hunt for as Futaba quickly rushes inside.
lines.zh: 我转过身，看见了我们在找的那家书店的招牌，而 Futaba 已经飞快地冲了进去。

lines.en: She's so excited that she forgets to even hold the door open for me- and under normal circumstances, I’d consider this incredibly rude.
lines.zh: 她太兴奋了，连替我扶一下门都忘了——换作平时，我会觉得这非常失礼。

lines.en: But I know she doesn’t mean any harm by it today.
lines.zh: 但我知道她今天不是故意的。

lines.en: She’s just having a hard time containing herself.
lines.zh: 她只是控制不住自己。

lines.en: Kind of like how I am whenever I see her in her pajamas.
lines.zh: 就像我看到她穿睡衣时的样子。

lines.en: But that's probably not a thing I should be having an inner monologue about when my {i}date{/i} is running around inside of a book store.
lines.zh: 不过，当我的{i}约会{/i}对象正在书店里跑来跑去时，我大概不该在心里独白这种事。

lines.en: scene joyoflife1
: Wow! Just look at everything, [futabamaster]!
lines.zh: : 哇！你看这里的一切，[futabamaster]！

lines.en: : There’s even more than the library in here!
lines.zh: : 这里甚至比图书馆还多！

lines.en: I wind up needing to follow Futaba up a staircase as she immediately climbs to the highest point of the bookstore.
lines.zh: Futaba 一进门就往书店最高处爬，我只好跟着她上了楼梯。

lines.en: She's not kidding when she says there's more in here than the library. This place feels like somewhere you can get lost in if you're not paying attention.
lines.zh: 她说这里比图书馆还多，真不是开玩笑。这地方给人的感觉是，稍不留神就会在里面迷路。

lines.en: I’m actually pretty shocked, to say the least.
lines.zh: 说真的，我相当震惊。

lines.en: From the outside, this shop seemed relatively small.
lines.zh: 从外面看，这家店算是比较小。

lines.en: But the inside is like a whole new world.
lines.zh: 可里面完全是另一个世界。

lines.en: A world full of wonderful things.
lines.zh: 一个充满美好事物的世界。

lines.en: At least by Futaba’s standards.
lines.zh: 至少按 Futaba 的标准是这样。

lines.en: Me? I honestly couldn’t care less.
lines.zh: 我？说实话，我一点都不在乎。

lines.en: scene joyoflife2
: Isn’t this amazing? It’s even better than I dreamt it would be.
lines.zh: : 这难道不棒吗？比我做梦时想的还要好。

lines.en: : You actually dreamt about a book store?
lines.zh: : 你还真梦到了书店？

lines.en: : Mhm! I dreamt that you and I would come here...and that there’d be millions of stories waiting to be cracked open.
lines.zh: : 嗯！我梦见你和我一起来这儿……还有无数个故事等着被翻开。

lines.en: : And that you’d pull one of the books from one of the shelves and start reading to me.
lines.zh: : 然后你会从书架上抽出一本书，开始念给我听。

lines.en: : Then, I'd rest my head on your shoulder and-
lines.zh: : 然后，我会把头靠在你肩上，然后——

lines.en: scene joyoflife3
: Actually, can you forget I told you about that dream? It started getting really embarrassing once I said it out loud.
lines.zh: : 其实，你能忘掉我跟你说过那个梦吗？一说出口就变得特别难为情。

lines.en: : Done.
lines.zh: : 已经忘了。

lines.en: scene joyoflife4
: I mean...It’s not like I’d try to stop you if you {i}did{/i} do something like that, though...Hahahah...
lines.zh: : 我的意思是……要是你{i}真的{/i}那么做了，我也不会拦你就是了……哈哈哈哈……

lines.en: Futaba, overcome by what seems like sensory-overload, begins to forget how to filter her dialogue.
lines.zh: Futaba 像是被感官过载淹没了，开始忘记怎么给自己的话把关。

lines.en: Her fingers pick at the wooden finish of the barrier in front of her as her eyes dart to the side and scan the rest of the store.
lines.zh: 她的手指抠着面前栏杆的木漆，眼睛则瞟向一旁，把店里其他地方扫视了一遍。

lines.en: It’s like paradise to her.
lines.zh: 对她来说，这里就像天堂。

lines.en: And here she is, alone with the one person who can make her heart flutter even more than words can.
lines.zh: 而她现在，正和那个能让她的心跳比任何言语都更剧烈的人单独待在一起。

lines.en: It’s not conceited to say that, is it?
lines.zh: : 这么说不算自大吧？

lines.en: scene joyoflife5
: Are you going to buy anything, [futabamaster]? Is there something in particular you’re looking for?
lines.zh: : 你要买点什么吗，[futabamaster]？有什么特别想找的书吗？

lines.en: : I don’t think this place has one of those computers that more modern stores have where you can search the inventory for a particular book but-
lines.zh: : 我想这儿应该没有那种现代书店里的电脑，可以查库存里有没有某本书，不过——

lines.en: : I’ve gotten really good at finding things from working in the library! And I can help you if you want!
lines.zh: : 我在图书馆工作练出来的找书本事可厉害了！你要是愿意，我可以帮你！

lines.en: : It’s fine. I’m just here to spend time with you.
lines.zh: : 没关系。我只是来陪你的。

lines.en: scene joyoflife6
: Huh?
: Does that surprise you?
lines.zh: : 这让你意外吗？

lines.en: : A little bit, yeah...I figured you would probably buy at least {i}one{/i} thing...
lines.zh: : 有一点，嗯……我以为你至少会买{i}一样{/i}东西……

lines.en: : And hearing you say this was all to spend time with me...made my heart skip a beat or two.
lines.zh: : 而听你说这一切都只是为了陪我……让我的心跳漏了一两拍。

lines.en: : That’s probably because you’re in love with me.
lines.zh: : 那大概是因为你爱上我了吧。

lines.en: scene joyoflife7
: Keh-!
: Is that like, a new reflex for you or something?
lines.zh: : 这算是你的新反射动作之类的吗？

lines.en: scene joyoflife8
: Unfortunately, I think it is...
lines.zh: : 遗憾的是，我想是的……

lines.en: scene joyoflife5
: But...I guess you’re probably right. My heart {i}does{/i} seem to be skipping a lot lately.
lines.zh: : 不过……我想你大概是对的。最近我的心跳{i}确实{/i}经常漏拍。

lines.en: : I’m sure you have at least {i}some{/i} part in that.
lines.zh: : 我敢说，其中至少有{i}一部分{/i}是因为你。

lines.en: : Wow, who could have ever predicted this?
lines.zh: : 哇，这谁能预料到啊？

lines.en: scene joyoflife9
: Heheh! I know, right?
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿！就是说啊！

lines.en: : It’s almost like I can’t help but wear my heart on my sleeve around you or something...
lines.zh: : 就好像我在你身边怎么都藏不住自己的心思似的……

lines.en: A long pause follows Futaba’s innocent laughter.
lines.zh: Futaba 天真的笑声之后，是一段长长的沉默。

lines.en: Her fingers stop picking at the finish of the barrier and begin to tremble instead.
lines.zh: 她的手指不再抠着栏杆的漆面，而是开始发抖。

lines.en: She takes a deep breath.
lines.zh: 她深吸了一口气。

lines.en: And then makes a horrible mistake.
lines.zh: 然后犯下了一个可怕的错误。

lines.en: scene joyoflife10
: I like you.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢你。

lines.en: : I know you know that already. But I wanted to...finally say it out loud.
lines.zh: : 我知道你早就知道了。可我还是想……终于把它说出口。

lines.en: : You don’t have to say anything back...I’m not an idiot.
lines.zh: : 你不用回应什么……我又不是傻子。

lines.en: : I know how weird it is for a student to confess to her teacher...
lines.zh: : 我知道学生向老师告白有多奇怪……

lines.en: : And I know you’re probably only spending time with me because I don’t say no to doing {i}that{/i} kind of stuff with you...
lines.zh: : 我也知道，你大概只是因为我不拒绝和你做{i}那种{/i}事，才愿意陪我……

lines.en: : And...I’m honestly okay with that as long as it means that, at least every once in a while...we can do things like {i}this{/i} together.
lines.zh: : 而且……老实说，只要这意味着我们至少偶尔能……一起做{i}这样{/i}的事，我就无所谓。

lines.en: scene joyoflife11
: N-Not to say I don’t like doing all of that other stuff! It’s actually...really exciting...and...umm...
lines.zh: : 我……我不是说我不喜欢做那些别的事！其实那……挺刺激的……而且……嗯……

lines.en: scene joyoflife12
: {i}Ugh...What am I even saying right now?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}呜……我到底在说些什么啊？{/i}

lines.en: : Futaba.
lines.zh: : Futaba。

lines.en: scene joyoflife13
: Y-Yeah?...
: I’m not just using you.
lines.zh: : 我不是只把你当工具。

lines.en: : You know that, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道的，对吧？

lines.en: : You’re...not?
lines.zh: : 你……不是吗？

lines.en: : No. How many times do I need to say that?
lines.zh: : 不是。这种话我要说多少遍？

lines.en: scene joyoflife14
: Ummm...
: A million?...
lines.zh: : 一百万遍？……

lines.en: : I don’t think I have that kind of time...
lines.zh: : 我好像没有那么多时间……

lines.en: scene joyoflife15
: I know, [futabamaster]...
lines.zh: : 我知道，[futabamaster]……

lines.en: : And I’m trying to understand...Really...
lines.zh: : 而且我在努力去理解……真的……

lines.en: : I just never really expected someone as amazing as you to take the time to actually {i}listen{/i} to me.
lines.zh: : 我只是从没想过，像你这么出色的人会真的花时间{i}听{/i}我说话。

lines.en: : I always think that my...feelings fall on deaf ears or that...I’ll be bothering someone if I open up to them.
lines.zh: : 我总是觉得……我的感受会被人当耳旁风，或者……我要是对谁敞开心扉，就会打扰到人家。

lines.en: scene joyoflife12
: And...while I admit that you’re a lot...umm...{i}hornier{/i} than I thought you’d be...I still know that you listen.
lines.zh: : 而且……虽然我承认你比我想象中要……嗯……{i}好色{/i}得多……可我知道你有在听。

lines.en: : I’m sure there’s some sort of motive for it, whether it be l-l-liking me back or not, but...It’s still kind of hard to believe when I really think about it.
lines.zh: : 我敢说这背后总有某种动机，不管是不是……喜……喜欢我，不过……真要仔细想，我还是很难相信。

lines.en: : And I feel like even if you {i}did{/i} tell me a million times that's not the case...there’d be a voice in the back of my head saying, “Don’t do it, Futaba! It’s a trap!”
lines.zh: : 而且我觉得，就算你对我{i}说了{/i}一百万遍不是那样……我脑子里还是会有一个声音在说：“别上当，Futaba！这是陷阱！”

lines.en: scene joyoflife15
: But...I’ve decided-
lines.zh: : 不过……我决定了——

lines.en: : Even if this is a trap...and you {i}are{/i} just using me for weird stuff-
lines.zh: : 就算这是陷阱……就算你{i}只是{/i}把我拿来干些奇怪的事——

lines.en: : I’m not.
lines.zh: : 我不是。

lines.en: : Right. But if you {i}are{/i}...I’m fine with it.
lines.zh: : 对。但如果你{i}是{/i}……我也无所谓。

lines.en: : That’s just how much I like you.
lines.zh: : 我就是这么喜欢你。

lines.en: I’m glad that this book store isn’t as crowded as I initially thought it would be.
lines.zh: 我很庆幸这家书店没有我一开始想的那么拥挤。

lines.en: Because, if it were, I’m sure there would be plenty of eyes on us right now.
lines.zh: 因为如果人多，我敢肯定现在会有很多双眼睛盯着我们。

lines.en: But, being so high above the only other people in the store, no one can hear us.
lines.zh: 不过我们站得比店里仅有的几个人高出许多，没人听得见我们。

lines.en: Futaba’s confession has fallen on me and me only.
lines.zh: Futaba 的告白只落在了我一个人的耳朵里。

lines.en: But it’s a twisted one with an unwarranted dark side to it.
lines.zh: 但这是一份扭曲的告白，还带着一丝无端的阴暗。

lines.en: Sure, I might be pursuing a number of girls right now, but it’s not like I feel absolutely nothing when it comes to this one.
lines.zh: 没错，我现在可能在追好几个女孩，但这不代表我对她毫无感觉。

lines.en: I do like her. As much as I can.
lines.zh: 我确实喜欢她。在我能做到的范围内。

lines.en: I think.
lines.zh: 大概吧。

lines.en: I don’t know.
lines.zh: 我不知道。

lines.en: It’s gotten annoyingly hard to tell what I really think as of late.
lines.zh: 最近越来越难搞清楚我真正的想法了，烦人。

lines.en: But as the two of us stand amidst stacks and stacks of stories under the warm light of a temporary sanctuary-
lines.zh: 可当我们两个站在一摞又一摞故事之间、沐浴在这片临时庇护所温暖的光下——

lines.en: There is one thing that rings true in my mind.
lines.zh: 有一件事在我脑海里无比清晰。

lines.en: And, it’s that I can not accept this confession.
lines.zh: 那就是，我不能接受这份告白。

lines.en: : Futaba.
lines.zh: : Futaba。

lines.en: : ...[futabamaster].
lines.zh: : ……[futabamaster]。

lines.en: : I can’t reciprocate your love.
lines.zh: : 我无法回应你的感情。

lines.en: : Like I said, I’m okay with being-
lines.zh: : 我说过了，就算被——也没关系。

lines.en: : Yet.
lines.zh: : 暂时。

lines.en: scene joyoflife16
: What do you mean by ‘Yet?’
lines.zh: : “暂时”是什么意思？

lines.en: : I mean that it feels wrong standing next to you and hearing that you’re okay with me using you as long as the two of us go to a book store every once in a while.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，站在你身边，听你说只要我偶尔陪你去一次书店、你就不介意被我利用，这让我觉得不对劲。

lines.en: : So...wait.
lines.zh: : 所以……等等。

lines.en: : I’m not sure what you’re saying. Do we need to stop...hanging out? Did I mess things up? Because-
lines.zh: : 我不太明白你的意思。我们是不是不能……再一起玩了？是我搞砸了吗？因为——

lines.en: : No. You didn't mess anything up.
lines.zh: : 不。你什么都没搞砸。

lines.en: : It’s just clear to me that your confidence isn’t where it needs to be yet.
lines.zh: : 只是我看得很清楚，你现在的自信还不到该有的程度。

lines.en: : And until it is, no confession of yours can possibly stick.
lines.zh: : 而在那之前，你的任何告白都不可能成立。

lines.en: scene joyoflife17
: But...
lines.zh: : 可是……

lines.en: : But what if it never gets to where it needs to be?
lines.zh: : 可要是它永远到不了那个程度呢？

lines.en: : What if I can’t ever be happy with who I am?
lines.zh: : 要是我永远都无法接受自己呢？

lines.en: : Then what?
lines.zh: : 那怎么办？

lines.en: : I stay on-hold forever?
lines.zh: : 我就这样一直被挂着？

lines.en: : You won’t stay on hold forever. I’ll help you.
lines.zh: : 你不会被一直挂着的。我会帮你。

lines.en: : How?
lines.zh: : 怎么帮？

lines.en: : I don’t know. But I’ll figure it out.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。但我会想办法。

lines.en: : That's part of my job, isn't it?
lines.zh: : 这也算是我工作的一部分吧？

lines.en: : You promise?
lines.zh: : 你保证？

lines.en: : I promise to try.
lines.zh: : 我保证会尽力。
: 那么……

lines.en: : So, can I try confessing again once my confidence gets a little better?
lines.zh: : 那么，等我的自信稍微好一点之后，我可以再告白一次吗？

lines.en: : If I do it again after that...will you actually take it seriously?
lines.zh: : 要是那时候我再告白……你会认真对待吗？

lines.en: : You can try confessing whenever you want and I’ll listen each and every time.
lines.zh: : 你想什么时候告白都可以，而且每一次我都会听。

lines.en: : But you're right. I won't look at it seriously until I know for sure that you're not treating yourself like some sort of tool.
lines.zh: : 不过你说得对。在我确定你没有把自己当成某种工具之前，我不会认真看待它。

lines.en: scene joyoflife18
: I like you...
lines.zh: : 我喜欢你……

lines.en: : I already told you, I’m not-
lines.zh: : 我说过了，我不是——

lines.en: : You told me I can confess whenever I want. So I did it again.
lines.zh: : 你说了我想什么时候告白都可以。所以我就又告白了一次。

lines.en: : Oh. Well, uhh...thanks?
lines.zh: : 哦。那个，嗯……谢谢？

lines.en: : No, thank {i}you{/i}.
lines.zh: : 不，该说谢谢的是{i}我{/i}。

lines.en: : For everything...
lines.zh: : 谢谢你的一切……

lines.en: scene joyoflife19
: But, umm...
lines.zh: : 不过，嗯……

lines.en: Futaba pauses once again.
lines.zh: Futaba 又一次停顿下来。

lines.en: Her fingers go back to peeling paint off of the barrier.
lines.zh: 她的手指又开始剥栏杆上的漆。

lines.en: : I guess we should probably start shopping now, huh?
lines.zh: : 我想我们大概该开始逛了吧？

lines.en: : We’ve kinda...been up here for a while and I think the employees might think we’re up to something...
lines.zh: : 我们……在上面待得有点久了，我觉得店员可能会以为我们在搞什么……

lines.en: : Then lead the way. Like I said, I’m here to spend time with you. Go browse to your heart’s content and I'll just...silently follow you or something.
lines.zh: : 那带路吧。就像我说的，我是来陪你的。你尽情逛，我就……默默跟在你后面什么的。

lines.en: scene joyoflife20
: {i}*Sniff*{/i} Okay!
lines.zh: : {i}*抽鼻子*{/i} 好！

lines.en: : But please bear with me! This might take a while~
lines.zh: : 不过请多担待！可能会花上不少时间~

lines.en: scene black
It did take a while.
lines.zh: 确实花了不少时间。

lines.en: Nearly two hours.
lines.zh: 将近两个小时。

lines.en: But they were two hours I wouldn’t trade for the world.
lines.zh: 但那是给我全世界我也不换的两个小时。
